findings.title: The node_modules exemption from the hard-link refusal is a free-floating path-segment regex, so any directory named node_modules anywhere in the tree re-opens the hard-link hole.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:74 NODE_MODULES_SEGMENT and :124. Reproduced: data/node_modules/evil/hard.txt and ts/src/node_modules/evil/hard.txt, hard links to an outside secret, served 200 via /@fs and root-relative URLs.
findings.consequence: Anyone who can write under the allow-listed tree can read any file the dev server can read.

findings.title: Import queries other than ?raw are re-read by name by Vite plugins after the check, and the race window leaks.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:362 load hook pass-through. /data/race.svg?import&url raced against a toggler: 122 of 544 responses carried the outside file.
findings.consequence: Disclosure under a race through ?url, ?inline or ?worker imports.
